display_title: If You Pick Up a Suspicious Husband
description:
Deep in the mountains, among the people of Yeong-Ji who say that a woman's happiness is marriage, a suspicious man with a somewhat naive look that I picked up in the garden near my house a while ago appeared. The man introduced himself as my husband..., but whenever this happens, the look in this man's eyes looks dangerous? 

Jayden, who is unconventional and ignorant of the ways of the world, but has a great appearance. She comforted and appeased the beastly man, making him human, and furthermore, tamed him to her taste. However, the people who came to find this man a while later seemed amazing. 

*"I came to pick you up, hyung."*

It seems that the status of this naive husband that I picked up is not ordinary. 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
